cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 21 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 21 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 27 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: overdue — the bigger cycle is stretched, expect more volatility
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 27 周，典型周期为 16–26 周

cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在后半段见顶（“右移”）——强周期见顶偏晚，属于健康上涨趋势的信号。

ladder.early_note: ⚡ Early topping signs (heads-up): MACD histogram rolled over off a peak (pre-cross). These anticipate a high BEFORE confirmation — a heads-up to protect gains, not a sell trigger yet.
ladder.why_zh: 周期中段（第 21 天）且短期超买 （StochRSI 95）。
ladder.next_zh: 并非做空信号——只是此处不宜加仓；回调至 10 日均线属于正常现象。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — weekly momentum positive; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue（投资者周期第 27 周 · 已失败 · 日线周期第 21 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：接近高点。大局（逆势）：看空。

ladder.early_note_zh: ⚡ 提前出现的做顶迹象（heads-up）：MACD histogram rolled over off a peak (pre-cross)。这些信号会在确认之前预判高点——属于保护利润的提示，而非卖出触发信号。
